method: Structured JSON from the Gemini API, instructed by docs/PROJECT_VISION.md@main blob fe2f414774b7. characters.summary: Derrick Rose fights as an explosive, hyper-athletic point guard who utilizes blinding first-step quickness, elite body control, and acrobatic finishes at the rim.
weaknesses: History of severe knee injuries limiting lateral explosiveness
limitations: Vulnerable to recurring lower body soft-tissue and joint injuries

sources.supports: Career history, playstyle, and MVP achievements in the NBA.

notableResults.note: Played against LeBron James and Dwyane Wade's Heat defense.

unknowns: Exact peak athletic trajectory had injuries not intervened.

characters.summary: Devin Booker operates as a premier shooting guard and perimeter scorer, utilizing deep range, elite footwork, and exceptional shot-creation to break down defenses.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to aggressive physical double-teams and trapping defenses
limitations: Relies heavily on perimeter rhythm and shooting efficiency

sources.supports: Scoring achievements, playstyle, and career highlights in the NBA.

notableResults.note: Faced Giannis Antetokounmpo in a six-game series.

unknowns: Defensive ceiling against elite playmaking point guards.

characters.summary: Dikembe Mutombo functions as an elite defensive anchor and rim protector, utilizing exceptional height, timing, and wingspan to block shots and secure rebounds.
weaknesses: Limited offensive creation outside of the immediate paint
limitations: Low offensive scoring volume outside of close-range opportunities

sources.supports: Defensive accolades, shot-blocking records, and career overview.

notableResults.note: Led 8th-seeded Nuggets to an upset win over the 1st-seeded SuperSonics via defensive dominance.

unknowns: Performance in modern pace-and-space offensive systems.

characters.summary: Dirk Nowitzki fights as a revolutionary stretch-four and scoring forward, utilizing his signature unblockable fadeaway jumper and deep three-point range.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to quick, agile guards in isolation perimeter matchups
limitations: Slower lateral quickness on defense in later career stages

sources.supports: Shooting profile, MVP season, and NBA championship run.

notableResults.note: Led the Mavericks to a championship victory against Miami's star trio.

unknowns: Defensive impact if deployed as a primary center against dominant post players.

characters.summary: Doc Rivers operates primarily as a tactical strategist and vocal leader from the sideline, orchestrating team adjustments and defensive schemes.
weaknesses: Dependent on roster personnel executing the gameplan
limitations: Does not participate directly in physical combat

sources.supports: Coaching career, 2008 NBA Championship, and playing history.

notableResults.note: Coached the Boston Celtics to a championship victory.

unknowns: Ability to win without elite multi-All-Star rosters.

characters.summary: Dominique Wilkins fights as a high-flying, explosive scoring forward, renowned for ferocious drives, powerful dunks, and unrelenting offensive pressure.
weaknesses: Occasional lapses in off-ball defensive focus
limitations: Relies heavily on high-energy offensive output

sources.supports: Scoring titles, athletic profile, and career achievements.

notableResults.note: Engaged in a legendary scoring duel with Larry Bird.

unknowns: Playmaking consistency against double-teams compared to elite passing forwards.

characters.summary: Don Nelson operates as an innovative tactical mastermind, utilizing unorthodox strategies like 'Run TMC' and the 'Nellie Ball' small-ball center lineup to outscheme opponents.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physically overpowering low-post interior offenses
limitations: Tactical risk-taking can leave teams defensively exposed on the boards

sources.supports: Coaching innovations, tactical history, and career wins record.

notableResults.note: Led the 8th-seeded Golden State Warriors to an upset over top-seeded Dallas.

unknowns: Effectiveness of extreme small-ball against all-time dominant traditional centers.

characters.summary: Draymond Green fights as a versatile defensive mastermind and elite facilitator, anchoring team defense with high basketball IQ and orchestrating the offense from the high post.
weaknesses: Prone to technical fouls and emotional volatility that can lead to ejections
limitations: Low individual scoring volume compared to primary offensive guards and wings

sources.supports: Defensive Player of the Year awards, playmaking role, and championship history.

notableResults.note: Contributed heavy defensive versatility and playmaking during Warriors championship run.

unknowns: Offensive production if placed on a team lacking elite off-ball shooters.

characters.summary: Dwight Howard operates as an overpowering interior force and elite rim protector, utilizing immense physical strength, leaping ability, and shot-blocking power.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to poor free-throw shooting, enabling intentional fouling strategies
limitations: Inability to reliably convert free throws under late-game pressure

sources.supports: Three-time Defensive Player of the Year, Magic finals run, and career stats.

notableResults.note: Dominated LeBron James's Cavaliers to lead Orlando to the NBA Finals.

unknowns: Compatibility with modern floor-spacing systems requiring perimeter shooting from the center position.

characters.summary: Dwyane Wade fights as an elite slashing guard and fierce perimeter defender, utilizing exceptional burst, exceptional shot-blocking from the guard position, and clutch scoring.
weaknesses: Susceptible to perimeter shooting droughts from three-point range
limitations: Prone to knee injuries and physical wear over long seasons

sources.supports: 2006 Finals MVP, scoring titles, and defensive records for guards.

notableResults.note: Carried Miami from a 2-0 deficit to four straight wins for the championship.

unknowns: Long-term shooting efficiency in an era dominated by high-volume three-point shooting.
